app.title: E-Ink Assistant
display.mark: Khetha izibonisi zakho ze-e-ink ukuze uvule ukulungiswa kwazo.
hardware.notice.title: Qala ngokusetha ukugqama esibonisini uqobo
hardware.notice.body: Kumenyu yesibonisi uqobo, khetha **izinga lokugqama lehadiwe elilinganiselayo noma eliphansi kancane** ukuze uthole imiphumela engcono kakhulu kulolu hlelo lokusebenza.
hardware.notice.bigme: Isibonelo, i-Bigme B251 Pro (R2 FW V2.0): Imodi Yewebhu, Izinga Le-Gamma Lehadiwe 3, Ukugqama 50, Imodi Yokubuyisela Umbala ivaliwe.
saturation.title: Ukugcwala Kombala
saturation.caption: Nge-e-ink enemibala: kunxephezela uhla lwemibala oluncane. Kubuyiselwa esimweni sokuqala uma uphuma ohlelweni.
saturation.mhc2.compat: Indlela ye-MHC2 ku-Windows 10: iqinisekisiwe kuhadiwe ehloliwe. Ukusekelwa kusancike esibonisini nakumshayeli; ukuphuma kubuyisela iphrofayela yokuqala.
rgb.title: RGB
text.title: Ukugqama Kombhalo
text.caption: Kwenza umbhalo ube mnyama ukuze ufundeke kuphaneli enokugqama okuphansi. Okwenzelwe ukufunda.
video.title: Ukuthuthukisa Ividiyo (Khanyisa Izindawo Ezimnyama)
video.caption: Kukhanyisa izindawo ezimnyama kuphela. Kuvule uma ubuka amavidiyo nezithombe.
video.warning: Umbhalo uyakhanya: %@. Kungcono ukuvala lokhu uma ufunda.
video.blocked: Kuvaliwe uma Ukugqama Kombhalo kuvuliwe: kusebenzisa ithebula lehadiwe elifanayo kodwa kunemiphumela ephikisanayo.
text.detail.strong: Ukwenza mnyama ngamandla, kuhlanganise nombhalo wesibili.
text.detail.sharp: Kunamandla kakhulu, kwenza imiphetho yombhalo ofiphele ibe lukhuni kakhulu.
text.detail.solid: Ukugqama okuphezulu ngokusika kakhulu ephuzwini elimnyama: kuba mnyama kakhulu, kodwa kulahleka imininingwane empunga nemiphetho ethambile.
help.title: Kusebenza kanjani
help.saturation: Ukugcwala Kombala ne-RGB (i-e-ink enemibala): kubhala kabusha iphrofayela yombala yesibonisi ukuze kunxephezele uhla lwemibala oluncane nokutshekela embaleni othile. Amaphaneli amnyama namhlophe angakushiya ku-100%.
help.video: Ukuthuthukisa Ividiyo: kukhanyisa amathoni amnyama kakhulu kuphela. Amathoni aphakathi nezindawo ezikhanyayo azishintshwa.
help.tradeoff: Akukwazi ukuhlukanisa ividiyo emnyama nombhalo omnyama, ngakho ukugqama kombhalo kuyancipha. Kuba kubi kakhulu kuModi Emnyama. Kusebenzise kumavidiyo, ukuvale uma ufunda.
help.volatile: Zonke izilungiselelo lapha zidinga ukuthi uhlelo lusebenze: ukuphuma kubuyisela izibonisi esimweni sokuqala, ukuqalisa kusebenzisa izilungiselelo zakho futhi.
language.title: Ulimi
curve.title: Ijika lamanje
advanced.title: Okuthuthukile
advanced.note: Kufaka ijika ozisethela lona esikhundleni sokusethiwe okungenhla.
curve.gamma: Gamma (ngaphansi kuka-1 kuyakhanyisa, ngaphezu kuka-1 kwenza mnyama)
presets.title: Amajika alondoloziwe
presets.hint: Chofoza indawo engenalutho ukuze ulondoloze ijika lamanje, noma elondoloziwe ukuze ulisebenzise. Chofoza kwesokudla ukuze ubhale phezu kwalo noma ulisule.
shaking.title: Nciphisa Ukuthuthumela
shaking.info: Kuvala i-dithering yalesi sibonisi. I-macOS isebenzisa amaphethini amancane emibala (i-dithering) ukuze yenze ukushintsha kwemibala kube bushelelezi; iphaneli ye-e-ink igcina iphikseli ngayinye, ngakho iphethini ibonakala njengokucwayiza okungapheli. Kunomphumela ofanayo nowe-Stillcolor, kodwa kusebenza esibonisini esisodwa kunokuba kuzo zonke.
role.title: Vala i-Night Shift ne-True Tone ku-%@ kuphela
role.note: Kudinga iphasiwedi yomlawuli. Ushintsho aluhlehliswa uma uphuma ohlelweni.
role.restart: Nqamula lesi sibonisi bese usixhuma futhi ukuze usebenzise ushintsho.
welcome.title: Siyakwamukela ku-E-Ink Assistant
welcome.menubar.title: Uhlelo lwebha yemenyu
welcome.menubar: Chofoza isithonjana sencwadi ukuze uvule izilawuli.
welcome.bigme.title: Bigme B251 Pro
welcome.bigme.body: Sebenzisa Imodi Yewebhu, Izinga Le-Gamma Lehadiwe 3, Ukugqama 50, bese uvala Imodi Yokubuyisela Umbala.
welcome.other.title: Ezinye izibonisi ze-e-ink
welcome.other.body: Qala ngezilungiselelo zehadiwe ezilinganiselayo, bese ulungisa ngokucophelela kwimodi ethi Okuthuthukile.
system.title: Nciphisa Ukubonakala Ngale Nokunyakaza
system.hint: Kokubili kuyasiza ku-e-ink: ukubonakala ngale kwenza umbhalo ungacaci, kanti ukugqwayiza akusizi kangako kuphaneli enensayo.
system.guide: Faka umsizi we-E-Ink Assistant ukuze ulawule zombili izilungiselelo ndawonye.
system.ready: Sebenzisa iswishi ukuze uvule noma uvale zombili izilungiselelo.
system.installing: Kulindwe ukuqinisekiswa kokuthi Engeza Isinqamuleli ku-Shortcuts…
system.failed: Umsizi ubengatholakali. Qinisekisa ukuthi ungenisiwe, noma khetha Faka Umsizi Kabusha ngaphansi kokuthi Izinketho.
system.auto.note: Kuyavuleka uma kuxhunywa isibonisi se-e-ink esimakiwe, bese kuvaleka kuphela lapho kunqanyulwa isibonisi sokugcina se-e-ink esimakiwe.
system.install.title: Faka umsizi wokufinyeleleka?
system.install.intro: Nciphisa Ukubonakala Ngale nokuthi Nciphisa Ukunyakaza yizilungiselelo ze-macOS ezisebenza kuyo yonke isistimu. I-Apple idinga ukuqinisekiswa kanye ngaphambi kokuthi i-E-Ink Assistant izilawule nge-Shortcuts.
system.install.step1: I-E-Ink Assistant ivula umsizi ehamba naye ohlelweni lwe-Apple oluthi Shortcuts.
system.install.step2: Hlola amagatsha aqondile athi off/on nesenzo sokugcina esithi Akukho, bese uchofoza Engeza Isinqamuleli kanye.
system.install.future: Ngemva kokufaka, lo mugqa uba yiswishi yokuvula nokuvala. Ukuyisebenzisa kaningi kuphephile; ayiguquli isilungiselelo ingaqalanga ngokuhlola isimo saso.
system.install.auto: Ungakhetha ukulandela izibonisi ze-e-ink ezixhunyiwe. Uma kunamaphaneli amaningi, ukuvala kwenzeka kuphela ngemva kokunqanyulwa kwazo zonke izibonisi ze-e-ink ezimakiwe.
system.install.quit: Ukuphuma ku-E-Ink Assistant kuvala zombili izilungiselelo njalo.
system.install.scope: Umsizi wamukela Umbhalo kuphela, ubona imiyalo eqondile ethi “on” nethi “off”, uziba konke okunye futhi awukhiphi mphumela. Awuboniswa eShidini Lokwabelana, ku-Spotlight, Ezenzweni Ezisheshayo noma esikrinini esikhiyiwe. Ungasebenza ngemuva lapho i-Mac ikhiyiwe ukuze ukulandela izibonisi ngokuzenzakalela nokubuyisela izilungiselelo uma uphuma kuhlale kuthembekile. I-E-Ink Assistant ayifaki ohlwini, ayihloli futhi ayisebenzisi ezinye izinqamuleli zakho.
